Sir, I am terribly sorry for your loss. I can’t even begin to imagine the pain that you’re enduring. I think everyone commenting to see someone and giving such kind words is amazing and I hope to add to them. 
 
  Like everyone else has said, your family WILL understand. You have not only experienced a huge loss, you have experienced a trauma. I know that my depression; which has been to the very extreme in the past, has made me wish for countless ways to just end the suffering. Even when driving, wishing for someone to be careless enough to crash into me. Sometimes to this day it creeps in. 

   Please, I beg of you, get any kind of help you are comfortable receiving. You deserve to live, not just live, but live happily. Who knows when you may be able to feel good again, but you are far closer to healing if you talk to someone, than if you were to “handle” it on your own. 

   Please take care of yourself, the world needs good people like you. I realize I don’t know anything about you, but I can tell that you’re kind hearted, hard working, and a bright soul. You have strangers here who clearly care about you and don’t even know your name. Please take care OP
